decisions.reason: Showing help text on the label and inside the field does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting.
The help-text location decision does not change the existing behavior that in-field text is removed when a field becomes active.
The source specifies help-text placement but does not resolve or alter the separate grey-field visual-cue requirement.
Displaying help text in two locations does not change the requirement for a robust alternative to password-dependent legacy fields.
The source does not change the checklist control type or any attribute owned by this requirement.
The source does not change the dropdown control type or its Bestyrelsesmode application.
The help-text placement decision does not alter the calendar-style date input method.
The source concerns interactive-field help text and does not affect the template theme-color palette.
The source does not change automatic bullet creation when Enter is pressed.
The source's references to labels and fields are unrelated to bullet appearance and formatting.
The decision about help-text locations does not change any heading, title, or caption typography attribute.
The source does not affect manual line-break entry after pasting legacy content.
